gitCommit.subject: Portal: serve the approved legal and support pages on dukan.tsxmr.com
gitCommit.body:
Portal: serve the approved legal and support pages on dukan.tsxmr.com

The portal footer linked to tsxmr.com, whose pages are the pre-launch
texts. A portal build now serves the approved Dukan ERP texts itself at
/in-app/<page> (+ /fr, /ar): privacy and account deletion 1.1, the
others 1.0, effective 2026-11-04. Footer links are local; the page head
emits no tsxmr.com canonical or alternates; the edge rewrites the in-app
addresses to the shell. /admin stays unrouted in a console-less build.

Tests: every page in EN/FR/AR opened directly, versions, language
switch, footer links local, and a regression check that no link,
canonical or alternate points back to tsxmr.com's legal texts.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
